content:
@Antoine Chambert-Loir and I are working on PRing our construction of the universal divided power algebra. Most of our construction depends on #35804, which has not received reviews since we opened it a month ago. We thought it would be helpful to open a thread here to keep track of PRs related to this project:

  • (merged) #35804 introduces the definition DividedPowerAlgebra (as a ring).
  • #36434 provides the functoriality map between divided power algebras associated with a linear map of the underlying modules, and the weak universal property of the DPA.
  • #37037 contains some results about substitution of power series, needed for #37038.
  • #37038 introduces the exponential module.

  • #35828 defines homogeneous algebra morphisms between graded algebras and proves that the evaluation of a (weighted) homogeneous multivariate polynomial at adequate elements
    of a graded algebra defines a homogeneous algebra morphism.

  • #35830 defines multinomial coefficients (Multiset.multinomial).

  • #36419 adds a computation lemma.
  • #36501 defines the graded structure on the quotient of a graded ring by a homogeneous ideal (this will be split into three PRs).
I can have a look at #35804, I more or less know the math.
I am happy to help out as well :)
